chunks: But they denied him, and We seized them with the torment of the Day of Shadowing (when the cloud had rained down fire). It was indeed the torment of a terrible day!

key_terms.يَوْمِ الظَّلَّةِ: Day of Shadowing; a specific day of punishment involving a cloud

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the 'Day of Shadowing' (Yawm al-Zillah) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the specific divine retribution upon the Thamud or Hud's people, where a cloud (Zillah) brought both cooling shade and scorching fire, symbolizing the duality of God's mercy and wrath. The 'Day of Shadowing' serves as a typological precursor to the Day of Judgment, illustrating how denial of prophetic truth leads to tangible, historical consequences that reinforce the inevitability of divine justice.
